_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.99 / rev27v-gauge-42 preserves the valve during normal sealed primitive transitions while keeping STOP/fault venting. Shared PID seeding and delivered-output anti-windup corrections are included; Valinor retains its Max presets and measured-rate control profile.

Simulator recording diagnostics now use physical units and exact Arduino sequence delivery; NI logs retain failed-read timing and successful-read intervals. Protected flash/restore and the ten-minute seed-213 Valinor soak passed all 8 hard-gate cycles with 100.00% Arduino delivery and zero NI sample gaps. Mean deflation was 2.64 against the 3.0 mmHg/s command, with 3.2–10.9 mmHg peak overshoot. These remain performance limitations. Layout audits and smoke tests passed.

This release does not claim perfect MAP, universal pulse preservation or generalized cross-cuff SysID. Default and Valinor remain separate application/firmware channels.
